title: Value-Based Large Language Model Agent Simulation for Mutual Evaluation of Trust and Interpersonal Closeness
reasoning: The paper uses Schwartz’s theory of basic human values to conduct social psychology simulations regarding trust and interpersonal closeness. While values such as benevolence and tradition are discussed, the research focus is on social relationship formation and the replication of social science theories rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
